title: Gotu Kola & Bacopa Clarity Complex
body_html:
Gotu Kola & Bacopa Clarity Complex brings together a synergistic combination of traditional herbs and botanical extracts that have been valued for centuries in Ayurvedic and Traditional Chinese wellness practices. Featuring Gotu Kola, Bacopa, Astragalus, Cistanche, Maritime Pine Bark Extract, and Panax Ginseng, this formula is designed to complement a healthy lifestyle with daily botanical support. Each ingredient contributes to a well-rounded blend crafted for modern routines.

Whether you're a professional managing complex projects, a student preparing for demanding coursework, or someone who appreciates nootropic-inspired nutrition, this blend offers a convenient way to incorporate respected botanicals into your day. It is also well suited for individuals interested in adaptogens and traditional herbal wellness practices. The combination of herbs makes it an excellent addition to routines focused on maintaining mental performance and overall vitality as part of a balanced lifestyle.

Maritime Pine Bark Extract provides naturally occurring proanthocyanidins, while Astragalus, Cistanche, and Panax Ginseng have long histories of traditional use for supporting resilience and overall wellness. Gotu Kola and Bacopa have been widely used in Ayurveda to promote mental clarity and cognitive well-being as part of daily health practices. Together, these botanicals create a versatile formula designed to support focus, everyday energy, and normal cognitive function.*


Ingredients: Proprietary Blend (Gotu Kola Powder (Centella asiatica) (whole herb), Astragalus Extract (root), Bacopa monnieri Powder (whole herb), Cistanche Extract (Cistanche deserticola) (stem), Maritime Pine Bark Extract (Pinus pinaster) (std. to 65% Proanthocyanidins), Panax ginseng Powder (root)) 231mg, Gelatin (capsule), Microcrystalline Cellulose, Magnesium Stearate, MCT Oil, Silicon Dioxide.
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 30 capsules / 0.4 oz / 0.03 lbs / 11 g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 1 oz / 0.06 lbs / 28 g
Suggested use: Adults take one (1) capsule daily. For best results, take with 6-8 oz (177-237ml) of water or as directed by healthcare professional.
Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult a physician if pregnant, nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition.
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
